title: Sous-Vide Core-Temperature and Doneness Timer
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bbq:probe probe=water
| stats latest(temp_c) as bath_temp, earliest(_time) as start
| eval at_temp_since=if(bath_temp>=target_c,round((now()-start)/60,0),0)
| eval status=if(bath_temp>=target_c,"holding at temp","heating")
description: Confirms your sous-vide bath has reached and held its target temperature, and for how long, so food is both safe and perfect.
value: Sous-vide safety depends on time at temperature; tracking how long the bath has held target removes the guesswork from doneness.
implementation: Ingest the water-bath probe; run during a cook and surface bath temperature and time-at-target.
visualization: Single-value panels for bath temperature, status, and minutes at target.
grandmaExplanation: It checks that your sous-vide water has reached the right temperature and how long it has stayed there, so the food is safe and cooked just right.
